item.title: Van constantly parked on double yellows, 26th September
item.description:
It is constantly parked on double yellow lines, which then causes other vehicles to park opposite, making it extremely difficult to get in and out of the road safely. The Eastern European shop is also regularly doing the same thing with a VW ID.7. When vehicles are parked in this way, you cannot safely enter the road, and visibility when trying to exit the road is virtually non-existent. I have repeatedly reported the same van to the enforcement team, yet nothing seems to be done about it. The situation is becoming increasingly dangerous, and I am genuinely concerned that it is only a matter of time before a member of the public is hurt. At this point, it feels like reporting issues to Bexley Council is simply a waste of time. These parking issues are being reported repeatedly, but there appears to be no effective enforcement or action taken to prevent the problem from continuing.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Mayfield Road, Northumberland Heath, Greater London

item.title: Overgrown weeds are attracting flies and gnats which are entering property through windows, 26th September
item.description:
I would like to request that the overgrown weeds and vegetation in the area outside the property are cleared. The vegetation has become heavily overgrown and appears to be contributing to the ongoing pest issue in the area. In particular, we have been experiencing a significant problem with gnats and flies, and the damp, overgrown conditions around the drains and weeds seem to be providing a suitable environment for them to breed and gather. The vegetation is located directly outside the windows on the side of the property and the flies are subsequently entering the property and causing an infestation inside the flat. I would therefore appreciate it if the council could arrange for the overgrown weeds and vegetation to be cleared, as well litter and glass that has been left there for days Thank you

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 126, Peckham Hill Street, Peckham, Greater London
